audit: The Grand Line Archive — Stage 4B-1M Official Bandai inventory extraction and reconciliation

supplemental_catalogue_source.note: Inspected for OP-18 and EB-05; this PR head is 10 commits ahead of supplied baseline 448bc546 and was not merged/integrated.

counting_rules: Distinct card numbers counted from card-entry records, not card-number references inside effects.
Only OP/EB prefix-matching card numbers count as original base cards.
Other original card-number prefixes in product pages are reprint/product inclusions.
PRB page products consist of original OP/EB/ST card numbers; no PRB base-card count is asserted.
Page result totals, feed release printing keys and image identifiers are separate measures.
Image identifier matches do not prove successful HTTP/browser image loading.
